reviewPassage:
SHARED KITCHEN | Shelf and freezer card

Each household has one small space on the cooling shelf. Put your tray in that space in a covered container with handles so that others can move it without lifting the lid. The card clipped to the handle has two sides. Leave the side marked SHELF facing out while the tray is there. You may use the shelf for your tray, but you may not reserve a second space with an empty container.

When you transfer your tray to the freezer, turn the card over and write your assigned drawer number on the FREEZER side. Keep that number facing out so others can check it without turning the card. If you need to amend what you wrote, use the eraser beside the card rack. Before you close the freezer, check that the number is still legible.
reviewPassageZh:
共用廚房｜置物架與冷凍庫使用卡

每戶在冷卻架上有一小格空間。請用有蓋、帶把手的容器裝好托盤，再放入該格，這樣其他人不用掀蓋就能移動。夾在把手上的卡片有兩面。托盤放在架上時，請讓標示「置物架」的那面朝外。你可以把托盤放在架上，但不得用空容器預留第二格。

把托盤移到冷凍庫時，請翻轉卡片，在「冷凍庫」那面寫上分配給你的抽屜編號。將抽屜編號朝外，方便他人核對，不用翻動卡片。如果需要修改寫好的內容，請使用卡架旁的橡皮擦。關上冷凍庫前，請確認編號仍清楚可辨。
